title: TabDPT-Turbo: Efficient In-Context Learning for Tabular Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.01400v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tabular foundation models, driven by in-context learning, have rapidly grown in quality and popularity. However, recent approaches with either cell-based architectures or retrieval have sacrificed efficiency for raw performance, restricting their utility in situations where compute is limited or inference speed is crucial. We adopt an alternate approach, sticking with row-based attention while incorporating long context pre-training to eliminate the need for retrieval. By combining this with architectural improvements and SSL pre-training on a newly-sourced, larger corpus of real data results, we present TabDPT-Turbo, a model that provides comparable default performance to TabDPT v1.1 on TabArena-Lite, CC18, and CTR23, at orders of magnitude faster. In our experiments, TabDPT-Turbo is the fastest model overall among leading foundation models. We have released the new model as TabDPT v1.2 at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabD

translated_title: TabDPT-Turbo：面向表格预测的高效上下文学习
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型，受上下文学习驱动，在质量和普及度上迅速增长。然而，近期采用基于单元格架构或检索的方法为了原始性能牺牲了效率，限制了其在计算受限或推理速度至关重要的场景中的实用性。我们采用了一种替代方法，坚持基于行的注意力机制，同时结合长上下文预训练以消除对检索的需求。通过将这一方法与架构改进以及在新增的、更大规模的真实数据语料上的自监督预训练相结合，我们提出了TabDPT-Turbo，该模型在TabArena-Lite、CC18和CTR23基准上提供了与TabDPT v1.1相当的性能，但速度快了几个数量级。在我们的实验中，TabDPT-Turbo是领先基础模型中最快的模型。我们已将新模型作为TabDPT v1.2发布在https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabD。
tldr: TabDPT-Turbo通过结合行式注意力、长上下文预训练和自监督学习，在保持与TabDPT v1.1相当性能的同时，实现了数量级的速度提升，成为最快的表格基础模型。
en_tdlr: TabDPT-Turbo achieves order-of-magnitude speedups while maintaining comparable performance to TabDPT v1.1 by combining row-based attention, long-context pretraining, and self-supervised learning, making it the fastest tabular foundation model.
